subject.title: [Feature]: Add message deletion (unsend) capability to Feishu channel

question: Should the official Feishu plugin expose agent-triggered recall of the bot’s own messages, and if so should it use the existing channel-action policy rather than a new default-enabled setting?
rationale: The request adds a destructive user-facing capability whose safe default, discoverability, and permission behavior are product policy rather than a purely mechanical gap.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned recall support
options.body: Add the generic delete action in `extensions/feishu` with explicit own-message and Feishu-error handling, reusing established channel-action policy where possible.

options.title: Keep edit-only behavior
options.body: Retain the current Feishu action surface if maintainers do not want agents to retract delivered messages automatically.

options.title: Support it through an external plugin
options.body: Keep the bundled plugin unchanged and let a separately distributed Feishu extension own this optional destructive capability.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned recall support
recommendation.body: Add the generic delete action in `extensions/feishu` with explicit own-message and Feishu-error handling, reusing established channel-action policy where possible.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent public Feishu message-lifecycle work makes this the strongest available area-routing signal.
